text:
sam: Heads-up — Cobalt Pay (payments fintech) asked for a 10-day POC to replace VendorY. Main concerns: drop-in API (minimal client changes), identical response schema, and clear billing reconciliation. They want a smoke test next Thu. Who can own runbook + shim?

rita: I can run the POC and own acceptance criteria + staging. Need their current client code snippet, sample payloads, and the exact error codes they expect. Also confirm whether they rely on streaming sessions or plain HTTP responses.

omar: Ill take the shim. Plan: lightweight proxy that rewrites request/response fields and a prompt-normalizer for parity. Est 48h for MVP, additional 24-48h for edge-case error mapping. Need canonical examples.

kevin: Network & infra notes: we can peer a galileo-style VPC, or provide fixed egress IPs. For quick POC I'll reserve egress IPs 18.205.33.10 and 18.205.33.11. Also confirm if they need EU residency for samples.

sec-bot: sec: checklist required: SOC2 report, BYOK capability (note: BYOK only on Private; Dedicated can do attestation), SSO/SAML, retention policy, and incident SLA.

sam: Price ask: they want cost parity vs VendorY per-response billing. Recommend free credits for 10 days + a reconciliation CSV comparing token counts and cost estimates. OK?

rita: Acceptance criteria draft:
- 15 canonical requests match semantic parity >=0.92 by eval harness
- Response JSON keys identical for downstream parser in smoke cases
- p95 latency <450ms in their preferred region
- Billing reconciliation CSV delivered and validated by their ops
- Security questionnaire: no critical open items

omar: Tokenizer delta: VendorY tokenizes about +7% on our tokenizer. Ill add a token-report and a local script for them to run to reconcile. Will include a prompt preprocessor to align token counts.

sam: Can someone drop a curl example for the shim for them to run locally?

omar: Sure: 
curl -X POST https://poc.cobalt-shim.redwood.ai/v1/complete \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \ 
  -d '{"prompt":"<sample>","max_tokens":128}'
Responses mirror VendorY shape: {"request_id":"...","results":[{"text":"...","meta":{}}]}

kevin: infra: sandbox cluster cobalt-poc-2026 created, creds delivered via DM. Egress IPs reserved.

sec-bot: sec: flagged BYOK as potential blocker if Cobalt insists on HSM-managed keys. Please confirm preferred path: Dedicated+attestation or Private install.

rita: I'll ask Cobalt for ~200 anonymized request samples and their parser tests. Also request their SLA requirements and incident notification window.

sam: I'll schedule kickoff Tue 9am PT and attach questionnaire. If BYOK required and Private only, escalate to solutions eng and legal.

omar: Also adding deterministic sampling option for the POC to reduce nondeterministic diffs during parity checks.

rita: Add fallback note to runbook: if capacity limit hit, route to quantized variant and document small divergence expected.

sam: Perfect. Thanks all — will post the invite and upload files here after kickoff.
